title: The Road West: the whole road trip, Long Island to Los Angeles
prompt: A long panoramic strip map of a blocky voxel highway running from the right edge (Long Island, a green on-ramp from Camp Half-Blood) to the left edge (the Pacific), in the style of a Minecraft Dungeons world map, the land changing from right to left: the New Jersey Turnpike with a Greyhound bus station and a truck-stop diner; back roads to a garden-gnome emporium full of stone statues; St. Louis with the silver Gateway Arch over the Mississippi bridge; the Rockies and Denver with a rusting water park; the neon Las Vegas strip with a lotus-shaped casino; the Nevada desert with a gas station and a waterbed store; Los Angeles with palm trees, hills and a recording studio; Santa Monica's pier and beach. Between each town a roadblock across the road (a burning wrecked bus, a wall of stone statues, a raised bridge, a mudslide, a neon lotus gate, a barricade of waterbeds, a wall of black shadow, a storm on the beach), and truck stops, motels, billboards and overpasses along the way. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
